title: Add non-road ground support and automatic fall recovery
acceptance: slight departures from a Roadbed polygon no longer immediately enter an endless black void; the active streamed region provides a bounded non-road support/terrain surface suitable for the current flat prototype fixture

non-road support does not replace or duplicate the authoritative Roadbed driving surface and is clearly separated so T010 elevation/grade-separation work can replace or reshape terrain without creating false flat intersections

leaving the playable support region, falling below a configurable safety threshold, or otherwise entering an unrecoverable fall triggers the existing nearby-road recovery flow automatically instead of allowing an endless fall
render and physics ground/support lifecycle is bounded by the same active streaming policy rather than growing with total route distance
automated tests cover support lifecycle and fall-recovery triggering, and a browser pass demonstrates a controlled road departure and recovery
